race.comment: BEAUTIFUL BANTER (1) returned a better run last time, finishing in the money (17.58) at this track behind Redeem A Arcadia in a Grade 3/4. Has the early speed to land on the pace and can stick on. Has a win and three minor placings from four starts from this draw. Leading chance again. FABIO ZED (4) was responsible for a modest effort most recently when sixth at The Gardens over 400m behind Project Nemesis (23.78) in a Grade 5. Was in the money prior to that. Better than last start and can bounce back. THAT'S OKAY (3) jumped from this box last time and placed in a Grade 5 at this track over 300m, finishing third (17.69). Has a very consistent record off this same box, including two wins and three placings from nine starts. Worth following up. QUIRKY NACHO (2) was out of the frame here most recently but can atone.
